positions.source_passage: Using generative AI for any healthcare usage at the moment is too risky, both in terms of accuracy (so much hallucinating going on), and in terms of protecting my privacy. I want trained human minds caring for me and monitoring my health, not some flaws hallucinating AI device.
positions.position_gist: The commenter, writing as a cancer patient, opposes any current healthcare use of generative AI as too risky due to output inaccuracy/hallucination and privacy concerns, preferring trained human clinicians over AI devices; the comment does not engage the specifics of the two-axis risk framework.
